spans.text: # ARCC — combined Lite financial, credit, funding, market and document screen
## Request
Third attempt repairs CP5-L01/L02 only: five issuer-specific OVERALL
transmission cells and one explicit analyst monitoring row per screen. No
source fact, topic classification/rank, posture or upgrade target changed.
Transport-literal repairs from attempt2 remain.
One actual CP-L10 owner handoff covering CP-L10, CP-L20, CP-L23, CP-L30 and
CP-L40, in that order. Current host model with preceding context,2026-11-04,
sequential; no agents/provider calls or native accepted heads. Historical
FY2024/FY2023 annual scope, parent July2029 note market/legal sub-scope; not
current advice or a December2024 information-availability backtest.
Decision scope **SCREENING_ONLY**; execution basis **MIXED**. Every phase has
source gate **PARTIAL**, screen status **COMPLETE_WITH_GAPS** and structured
upgrade outcome **FULL_UPGRADE_REQUIRED** for a full decision. No automated
profile/run change or provider dispatch is performed. Current user authorization
governs later work; historical confirmation/controller rules are not inherited.
## Sources
CP-0.md extends the retained source admission. Original annual PDF SHA256
1-based annual-page refs A3,A35,A36,A73,A88,A89,A94,A95,A96,A99,A100,A115,A116,
A255,A283,A300. USD millions unless per-share, percentages or explicitly USDbn.
A=../arcc-2024-001/sources/annual-pages.txt, matching that original PDF.
| Handoff/source key | Actual source used / pin or locator | Scope limit |

| HM | ../arcc-market-2024-001/CP-3D-attempt-2.md; 1a13358ae2b689a3205d152f34d68ea63520c36c8c82db32452a03a4b2c6c1aa | Historical evaluated source; price basis/convention and executable status unresolved |
| B10.07 | Executed base indenture section10.07, retained base-lines L1384–1385 | Incorporated source test; do not invent a new Lite legal interpretation |

| scope | Selected/admitted source scope in CP-0 and this record | A missing selected input is not a claim that no such evidence exists anywhere |
Selected method is the archived five-screen CP-OS Lite runbook, joint policy,
five adaptive allocation references and five exact topic/table schemas. It
retains broader analytical duties absent from the later seven-KPI/two-quarter
runtime slice. Annual BDC evidence is not forced into that narrower slice or
industrial ratios. Source-owner fields below describe analytical responsibility,
not accepted full-owner upstream heads; direct source entry is permitted.
## Findings
The combined screen warrants deeper work on cash realization, funding timing,
market convention and the complete creditor-document perimeter. Higher reported
NII and cash balances provide counterevidence to a blanket deterioration view;
they do not settle cash sufficiency or asset quality. Thirty canonical topics
remain distinct. Missing ESG, forecast, liquidity-depth or permissions evidence
is an evidence request, not an adverse conclusion or an immateriality finding.
Attention ranks are analyst-assigned topic priority, not security or credit
scores. Input tuples are (urgency,downside magnitude,evidence confidence),
with the exact ordinal definitions frozen in instructions.md. Descending keys
then canonical topic order determine rank; each tuple is retained below. No
percentage-change threshold, weighting, output quota or claim cap is imposed.
